title: Thought through my eyes
html_source: Applies to Stephen’s and the reader’s thoughts as we only have what he relates to us to go on.

Ineluctable modality of the visible: at least that if no more,
anchor.suffix: . Signatures of all things I am here to read, seaspawn and seawrack, the nearing tide, that rusty boot. Snotgreen, bluesilver, rust: coloured signs. Limits of the diaphane. But he
